AI craft

I don’t just use AI. I direct it.

Good output starts with a good brief. I use ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude for different jobs, then edit hard so the result still sounds human and on-brand.

For visuals

Gemini and ChatGPT generate product scenes, illustrations and campaign imagery, which I refine in Canva.

Subject: hand-crocheted tote, rose pink
Scene: sunlit window, linen cloth, dried lavender
Style: soft editorial, warm tones, shallow depth
Frame: 4:5 for Instagram, room for text
Avoid: logos, extra hands, plastic sheen

For words

Claude and ChatGPT draft first versions of copy. I supply the voice, audience and facts, then rewrite.

Role: brand copywriter for an organic dairy startup
Audience: urban families who read labels
Voice: warm, honest, no hype words
Task: 60-word product story for A2 Bilona ghee
Rules: no health claims, keep it label-compliant
